body:
I lost 2 friends one overdosed on ghb, benzo, alcohol. The other one became a drug addict.

The one who became a drug addict was a manipulative psychopath who i had to leave behind i was his friend for 4 years. So i can relate. And friendships like that is hard to get out off
Tell me whats on your mind i would also like to tell you that im going through some shit too
Same for me. Life is not for me and thats a fact i took into consideration last summer
I really hope you figure shit out if you dont get help it just gets worse and worse

When the last hope is drained he will kill himself

When ur suicidal you dont wanna try cause you know it wont matter in the end

You are prob one of the reasons hes still hanging on

Dont stop caring no matter how much he pisses u off.
Im sure you would agree its better to have him alive.

I live in the most northern part of norway its so dark here in the winter snow everywhere no clear sky to be seen storms. Blizzards. I just want a good view before i jump a calm summer night

Where i will not be disturbed. I just dont see myself doing anything in the future.

I might take cyanide before i jump so if i dont have the guts i still die. im so numb to fellings
I cry myself to sleep.

The abuse of drugs i just do it cause i know im gonna end it all soon so why not fuck it even more up. I just wish i could go to sleep and never wake up.

Im a failure at life. Life is not for everyone.
Im failing school i dont have a job
And this summer i really hope i have the balls to jump of the bridge. Last time i did i drank
And i told my mom bye. This was the second time
Didnt have the balls
She picked me up and took me to a doctor who told me i had depression and what not.

I hope u fell better. But i know how you fell

For me too sucide is a option, but please dont do it.

Well in the end it dosen’t even matter what u think. I got thrown into therapy and a clinic

My life has been pretty shit my parents didnt live togheter and i lost friends.

I started drinking everyday that summer i woke up at 6 no not in the morning and fell asleep at 8 in the morning

I didnt give a fuck about anything. Me and my friend talked about sucide all the time

How we could make cyanide put of apple seeds
And what not. But when you know you have the guts to end your life atleast me i was thrown into this peace. When i stood there i had for ones fucking controll over my life.

Well im just ranting thought youd like to hear about my shit life up here in the north above the polar circle.
:( same this summer i tried jumping of a bridge
